verdict_note: These bars can prove that eighty-seven weapons are different. They cannot prove that any of them has an opinion, and in W1-10 they could not tell that not one of the eighty-seven was in the game. Six defects: four in the instruments, two holes where no instrument existed. All six fixed or filed; the area is not cleared until the CONSUMPTION and RI-WPN07 fixes have been RUN once.
biggest_weakness: The bars verify the artifact and not the game, and the blind tests - the one instrument supposed to be immune to that - are the worst offenders. W1-10 scored 0/10 with the movesets provably unreachable from the running game, and returned PASS on BOTH mandatory blind comparisons plus ARI, SEP, D_min, TDV and ILS. Six of seven headline numbers and both blind tests were green on a layer no player could touch.

referrals.question: Is Dg_min >= 1.0 reachable, or is the bar broken?
referrals.ruling: ARITHMETIC UPHELD, THRESHOLD HELD, DIMENSION SET REPLACED
defects_found_in_the_instrument: Reach misclassified as a mass dimension and excluded. corr with weight tier 0.586 vs motion value 0.889, poise 0.873, stamina 0.935 - the WEAKEST-correlated thing Dg discards, and the item's own How-we-lose #4 calls it geometry.

BOW inside the z-normalisation population. Its 22.0 m projectile range compresses the melee reach z-span from 3.599 to 0.542 - a 6.64x loss. NOT confined to Dg: D5 is one of the twelve dimensions of D_min and of RI-WPN03's F87, so D_min, D_med, SEP, W_min and W_med have all been read off a broken reach column. This is the bar critic's own finding; neither the weapon critic nor the builder found it.
Nothing looked past the first hit (AMENDMENT-W1-10-CRITIC-01 Defect 2, upheld).
referrals.remedy: RI-WPN02 section D: nine GRAMMAR_DIMS over the 14 melee classes - four pinned, reach admitted, hyperarmour, plus free chain-grammar dims G7 chain_arc_range, G8 chain_shape_count, G9 chain_root_ratio, all measured from hitbox records.

reachability_witness.note: All rows over the same 14 melee classes. D11 is a plainly narratable monotone ladder, not an optimised one. Reach alone moves SPR-TSW and does nothing for AXE-MCE; the chain triple does the reverse. Both repairs are required. Both new derived constraints are met on the nose (7/14 and 10/14 against floors of 7 and 10) - the witness is a floor design, not a comfortable one.

options_rejected.option_2_lower_to_0.90: REJECTED on principle. 0.90 was chosen because the build measured 0.914. A threshold reached by lowering it has stopped being a bar, and curve-fitting the corpus is worse than curve-fitting the roster because the roster is re-measured every wave.

clauses.clause: CRITIC-01 Defect 1 - ARI bands unreachable from below
clauses.correction: C_min = 664 assumed WITHIN-class sharing; section C never said so, so the true floor was ceil(S_total/4) = 517, ARI = 0.2504. SHARE scope now tightened to within-class in RI-WPN03 section C, which is what makes the floor real. With the chain-2 ruling C_min = 656, ARI_min = 0.3177.
clauses.note: The amendment's proposed 0.32 hard fail sat 0.0015 above the floor and would have been decorative.

clauses.clause: CRITIC-01 Defect 2 - nothing measures the chain
clauses.arithmetic: RI-CMB02 section C's chain multipliers are CLASS-UNIFORM (hit2 startup x0.78 recovery x1.05; hit3 recovery x1.35). Therefore Rh's ratio components are r1_recovery/r1_startup times a constant - a rescaling of a dimension Dg already has - and its gap components correlate -0.976 with r1_startup. Adding Rh to GRAMMAR_DIMS would have imported the most mass-correlated quantity in the corpus into the distance that exists to strip mass out. It raises Dg_min 0.458 -> 0.594; raw r1_startup alone gets 0.481 of that for free.
clauses.replacement: RI-WPN03 section D.3 Chg - the chain measured as a sequence of shapes, arcs, root travel and swing planes, from hitbox records. A chain is a sequence of swings, not a sequence of frame ratios.

clauses.clause: CRITIC-01 Rh_min < 0.03 as a hard fail (builder asked to defer to wave 2)
reasons: With class-uniform multipliers, Rh within a class is a function of frame overrides alone. A weapon whose deviation is a new clip, a new shape or a new arc - the expensive overrides RI-WPN03 section B distinguishes from parameter nudges, and exactly what DEV_id buys - sits at Rh distance 0 from its baseline and hard-fails. A hard fail that rewards nudging frames over authoring animation inverts WEAPON-CRITIC section 1 corollary 1.

BOW's chain is one link, so Rh is all padding and within-class Rh_min is structurally 0 for all five bows. Measured on the shipped roster BOW has ONE distinct chain-frame signature across five weapons. The threshold would have fired immediately on a roster the same corpus calls the strongest thing in the piece.

clauses.clause: -02 section D - downgrade the over-fragmentation bar to a warning
clauses.reason: The stated tension rests on a bar that does not exist. Section C requires UNQ >= 1 and DEV >= 4, not UNQ >= 4, and DEV is satisfiable by parameter overrides costing no clips. The floors force ARI to roughly 0.32-0.35 against a fragmentation bar at 0.60 - 0.25 of clearance. The builder's own roster disproves it: ARI 0.4547 with UNQ mean 3.70 and zero DEV_id == 0. It is the only bar in the area enforcing the second side of 'subtly unique' (WEAPON-CRITIC section 1 corollary 3). THIS IS THE ONE CLAUSE IN EITHER FILING THAT ARGUES FOR AN EASIER STANDARD RATHER THAN A BETTER ONE.

referrals.question: Does the corpus contain a Reach (m) ambiguity?
referrals.ruling: YES - real, live, and about to produce a FALSE FAILURE
referrals.detail: The column was used as both blade length and effective reach while M1 sub-probe C measured the largest hitting distance, which necessarily includes the root lunge. On UGS the two readings differ by 1.40 m against an M3 tolerance of +/-0.10 m - a factor of fourteen. The item would have failed a correct build, or been fixed by shrinking a blade.
resolution: Reach (m) is BLADE reach, root translation suppressed, so it stays independent of Root dz (a separate fingerprint dimension - otherwise D5 and D7 are partly the same number)
threat_m = Reach + Root dz, derived never authored, melee spread >= 3.0 m
S26 form of sub-probe C: C1 blade reach, C2 threat sweep, C3 body corridor, over 0.20-5.00 m, with CONTIGUITY A HARD FAIL and reach_min_m <= 0.60 m

S26 had never propagated to 12-weapons at all - the area with the largest root translations in the game (UGS 1.40 m R1, 1.90 m R2, against the 1.2 m hole S26 was written for). The old outward sweep was structurally incapable of seeing an interior gap.
